title: Cabling
description: T568A and T568B pin orders, and when to use straight-through or crossover cables.

exercises.prompt: Tap the wires in T568B order, from pin 1 to pin 8.
exercises.explanation: T568B: white/orange, orange, white/green, blue, white/blue, green, white/brown, brown.

exercises.prompt: Tap the wires in T568A order, from pin 1 to pin 8.
exercises.explanation: T568A: white/green, green, white/orange, blue, white/blue, orange, white/brown, brown. It is T568B with the orange and green pairs swapped.

exercises.prompt: A cable is terminated like this. What type of cable is it?
exercises.explanation: The same standard on both ends makes a straight-through cable.

exercises.prompt: A cable is terminated like this. What type of cable is it?
exercises.explanation: T568A on one end and T568B on the other makes a crossover cable.

exercises.prompt: Which cable connects a PC to a switch (unlike devices)?
exercises.explanation: Unlike devices (PC to switch, router to switch) use a straight-through cable. A rollover cable is for a device's console port.

exercises.prompt: Which cable connects a PC directly to another PC (like devices)?
exercises.explanation: Like devices (PC to PC, switch to switch) use a crossover cable: T568A on one end, T568B on the other. Many modern ports have Auto-MDIX and adjust automatically, but the exam rule is still crossover.

exercises.prompt: In the T568B standard, which wire is on pin 1?
exercises.explanation: T568B starts with white/orange on pin 1. T568A starts with white/green.

exercises.prompt: Match each connection to the cable it needs.
exercises.explanation: Unlike devices use straight-through; like devices use crossover.
